en: You return. What is that you carry?
Show Mysterious Orb
Activate Mysterious Orb
This craftsmanship. I would recognize it anywhere. It must come from the halls of the Chroniclers?
An insidious device. I'm relieved you chose not to activate it... Give it here.
It has been disarmed, in a manner of speaking.
Return it to its maker.
This craftsmanship... No! What are you doing?! Who gave you... This...?
Ah, perfect! I'm not certain they truly understand what pain is, but I pray they felt it.
Their meddling is unwanted here.
Undisturbed, I will be able to recreate every grain of sand. Every mote of dust.
Consider me in your debt.
...the alabaster plaza spanned the entirety of the eastern district. But how many spires lined the horizon? What color were the gemstones...?
Present Endless Kaleidoscope
Yes! Wonderful! This is what I need. I shall expand this world, recreate the splendor that once was.
But... something is not right.
...surely that is not how it was. The spires, the grand metropolis.
It was magnificent. Truly magnificent.
Truly...
Echo of the Vizier
The reflection dims... Who are you?
Intriguing development.
An aberration, to be sure... but of what nature?
You utilize my Mirrors, yet fail to grasp their underlying design.
My study remains deep within the palace halls. You may seek me there.
This Helmet...
How did it come to rest with you?
I understand.
At long last, an unlife fraught with misguided aspirations has ended. Perhaps it is for the best.
I will mourn the loss of our past.
You've shown kindness in bringing this to me. I can but reciprocate.
Unknown creation pattern. Contrasting. Hold. Irregular correlations. Spectrums of un-light.
Sensory input. Unknown. Allure. Primeval traces. Knowledge expanded. Records must be created.
Sensing the presence of another. Locate. Hunt. Fugitive. Hidden within the reflection. A window into the concept of before.
Something deflects our attempts to collect. World of glass will be understood. Indexed.
Make overtures. Transport Orb. Fugitive desires object.
Ruse. Unknown creation pattern will mediate. Fugitive will believe. Orb will neutralize. History will be created. We will study what remains.
Resources are plentiful. Rewards are generous.
Your choice has been recorded.
You return from the reflection.
Events have transpired. We must learn the cipher. Sift through the remains.
We will examine.
We will learn.
Actions recorded. Rewards dispensed.
Actions illogical.
Deception. Betrayal.
Nature of the Star.
Ah! Hello! I wasn't expecting to see someone else here.
You're not going to... pounce on me, are you? Haha...
Ose is the name! Archaeology is my trade.
So many things to find in this place. Just when I think I’ve found something to study, I spot something else!
Like this... Vault of sorts. I'd kill to know what trinkets might be hidden in there!
No, not literally.
Anyway, as far as I can tell, the mechanism seems broken, but look at the wall there.
It might still unlock, provided we could get our hands on one of the intricate Ancient Ciphers created by its makers.
I've yet to find one, but there must still be some hidden within the City.
The mechanism seems broken, but it might still open, provided we can find an Ancient Cipher. There must still be some hidden within the City.
You found one! I can't believe it. Quickly, let's see what lies within!
Alright, it seems to accept the Cipher!
What happens if I do this?
Ah, interesting. And let's try this.
I think I understand how this works now.
Oh, look, look! Can you see the pattern?
Just one more to the left.
There! We got it!
What happened? What is that thing?
The air feels... different. Tingly.
This isn't what I theorized at all. Why would they lock this away?
I must consult the scrolls... Thank you for your assistance. Travel safely.
Why would they lock this away?
Oh, we meet again! Splendid!
Perhaps we can work together. Tell me, what do you think of this curious contraption?
Beyond supposedly lies the great Court. If the stories are to be believed, it was sealed shut as the City fell. And so it remains, I'm afraid.
Oh, what discoveries lay behind this gate, I wonder...?
It opened! Wait... YOU did that? You can operate these arcane contraptions?
I wasn't ready for this. Everything is all over the place. You go ahead; I'll be right behind you.
Now, where did I put the magnifier...?
Did you ever find an Ancient Cipher?
After you left, I discovered this thing!
I used it as a reference to repair the other one. Well... I think I managed to repair it. Can't really be sure.
I can't believe it. Me, Ose, standing within the Gray Pyramid of the old legends.
What better place to pursue my studies than here, within the very cradle of civilization as we theorize it?
It will take years, no, decades to catalogue every crumbling piece of forgotten past hidden away within this place.
I can't wait.
I was looking into a peculiar phenomenon. Pray tell, have you come across these stones before?
They're quite strange. My instruments indicate some manner of energy lingering in the area. I can't quite wrap my head around it.
Wait, come again? They whisper to you?
Incredible. Say, if you come across more, please pay attention to what they tell you. You share it with me, okay?
Oh, and before I forget, take this. Not quite sure how it works, but I won't be needing it within these halls.
It's a pleasure to see you again, dearest friend. Well, not my dearest friend. A lifetime of friends makes it hard to choose a favorite, you know?
Do you need something, friend?
Share Recollections
Discoveries
These records boggle the mind. Once I think I've established a truth, a conflicting account emerges to disprove it.
It is the puzzle of a lifetime, history dancing at my fingertips. The Void, the Progenitor gods, the Heralds, the Red Star. So much to be understood.
Sorry, lost myself there for a moment. If you need anything, you know where to find me!
I've found records of something strange... Here, I'll mark the location on your map. Perhaps it could prove useful.
Sorry, friend. Got no new leads for you at this time.
Some of the scriptures with the Library... they make no sense! It's almost as if the texts are being rewritten right before my eyes. I can't explain it.

It's all jumbled, past and present. They say the gods vanished, but I'm not sure that explanation suffices. During every Emergence, traces of their essence can be observed, at least in some form. The unliving have come to call them Heralds, as I understand.
If they are who you seek, these texts should lead you to them. At least for now. I'll mark their locations on your map.
Fascinating. Truly, fascinating!
Such vivid descriptions, an unfiltered look into history!
I will write this down immediately. Please, I must know more!
You found another one? Fantastic work. Let me get my quill!
Quick, place it next to the others. We're nearly there... I can feel it. We stand at the cusp of a true scientific breakthrough.
The stones told you this? It... doesn't make scientific sense at all. The wonders of this world never cease!
Truly a remarkable job, my friend.
